criteria.title: Check and normalize records
criteria.evidence: Correct immutable records and all input checks, including amount limits, currency, and UTC times.

criteria.title: Read once and handle repeated IDs
criteria.evidence: Lazy single-pass input; validate before duplicate checking; counts and error classes are correct.

criteria.title: Update windows and return results
criteria.evidence: Correct prior-window rule, fixed-work updates, Decimal arithmetic, separate account state, and exact output schemas.

criteria.title: Measure time and memory
criteria.evidence: Repeat multi-size experiments; show medians, chart, environment, timing scope, and honest memory measurement.

criteria.title: Explain choices, copying, and limits
criteria.evidence: Explain findings, copy example, early events, changing baseline, ordering, total memory, and retention trade-offs.

criteria.title: Run and explain the work
criteria.evidence: 10 points for reproducible files, outputs, and recorded version; 10 for the oral explanation.

scoring_note: Tests provide evidence; do not assign points by counting tests. Instructor confirms final grades.
language_note: Use simple English. Assess correct meaning and evidence; do not penalize minor grammar errors when meaning is clear.
